project.author: WarpForge Examples
project.description: In-app editable menu — four colored button sprites (green +, orange pencil, red X, blue ▶ for Add / Edit / Delete / Open) drive a pair of parallel lists (labels + urls) shown as monitors. On flag click each button says its name and the title bar greets you. Click Add → ask for label and URL. Click Edit → ask which #, then new values. Click Delete → ask which # and remove. Click Open → ask which # and launch via the OS shell. Per-entry URL launch uses scratch_io_open_url with a connected scratch_data_item_of_list reporter.

workspace_state.blockly_xml:
<xml xmlns="https://developers.google.com/blockly/xml">
<block type="wf_window" id="window_main" x="24" y="24"><field name="HEIGHT">360</field><field name="TITLE">Menu Editor</field><field name="WIDTH">480</field><next><block type="wf_screen" id="screen_stage"><field name="NAME">Stage</field><field name="ROUTE">/</field></block></next></block>
</xml>

sprites.name: Title
